bands.name: Radio
bands.description: Long waves carry echoes of past events. Used for archives, radio signals, and historical records.

bands.name: Infrared
bands.description: Thermal signatures of what is happening right now. Heat, activity, live sensors.

bands.name: Visible Light
bands.description: The narrow band human eyes see. Real-time observation of the current moment.

bands.name: Ultraviolet
bands.description: Short-term future trends, UV damage, near-horizon projections.

bands.name: X-Ray
bands.description: High-energy scenarios. Deep future projections and rare events.

bands.name: Gamma Ray
bands.description: Extreme, high-impact scenarios. The highest energy, lowest probability events.
